# Genuine V0.6 fixture provenance

Captured on 2026-10-27 before V0.6.1 gameplay or schema changes.

`v0.6-chapter.json` is the unmodified schema 9 / balance 0.6.0 endpoint of
the actual 220-action, 15,055-second continuous route. It has no specialty
inventory and no A01-A03 optional archive unlock. Source route commit:
81de80fe32f400beec768c50dc40465cd4b470c4. The route used an uncommitted
lighting-preview fix, recorded by its game-source digest rather than falsely
attributed to HEAD. That transient preview does not enter saved state.

`scripts/v06-reference.mjs` extracts the published V0.6 game from commit
22d37466d40aea71d6e010b41a5961e5e88968dd, bundles it independently and replays
all 220 recorded actions at their exact simulated seconds. The resulting
complete state equals the source endpoint. `v0.6-route.json` retains this
action trace and original source digests. No stock, resident, version or
completion marker is filled or relabeled.

- `v0.6-chapter.json` SHA-256:
  e74a822ca6b34a1bbc583ddea67c78a8e8f5f0eceba90985e30111257d111823.
- `v0.6-ready.json`: six ordinary released-engine actions (two specialty mode
  choices, two outbound and two inbound dispatches) and real elapsed time
  produce and return two rainFilm and two railCore. SHA-256:
  40c74c48ac70cd5a70474601a5a0c1ee808db2392f4b0b143ab231e8bcb7dbcb.
- `v0.6-boundary.json`: genuine specialty modes, a delayed held rain calendar
  order, selected extend/coexist covenants, and an outbound station shipment.
  Every change uses released actions/advance, retained in the reference trace.
  SHA-256: b4f7b904170bff931831cebe0fb2be18bf5c7e2b4ed6cc103cb873ce2cbdcaa7.

For each case the published engine validates invariants, advances 86,400,517ms,
and records the entire state/report in `v0.6-offline-reference.json`, together
with per-file published-source hashes and fixture/trace digests. The temporary
extraction is removed after capture. New V0.6.1 code generates no expectations.

Reproduce with supported Node.js 22: `node scripts/v06-reference.mjs`.
The initial `--capture` option alone imports the existing analysis source;
ordinary reproduction uses only tracked fixtures and the published Git source.
These simulation-origin timestamps are not ready-to-import human playtest saves;
browser tests rebase clock metadata only and retain all economic values.
